# Popovers Café

> Family-owned café in downtown Apex, North Carolina, specializing in sweet and savory popovers baked fresh every morning, served with house-made butters and jams. Owners: Mustafa and Juliette Ozturk (Ozturk Restaurant Group). Chef: Landon (Culinary Institute of America, baking & pastry).

- Address: 219 N Salem St, Suite 103, Apex, NC 27502, USA (Salem Street Promenade)
- Hours: daily 7:00 am – 3:00 pm
- Phone: (984) 220-1577 · Email: mustafa@popoverscafe.com · Instagram: @popoverscafe
- Google rating: 4.9 (92 reviews, Sept 2026)

## Popovers (named after the family)
Savory: Anna's Original (served with signature butters or jams); Mama Mia (spinach, sun-dried tomato, gruyère); Massimo (jalapeño, white cheddar, honey butter); Lincoln (gouda, smoked bacon); Juliette (Mama Mia with a poached egg).
Sweet: Belle (bourbon caramel apple); Foster (dark chocolate, vanilla-infused filling); Pippa (blueberry lemon); Cole (coffee, hazelnut coffee-infused vanilla filling).

## Drinks and light options
Table-side pourover coffee (Peak City Coffee house blend), French press, Turkish black tea, Ceylon green tea, whipped honey coffee, iced Greek coffee, Summer Energy Spritzer; fresh-squeezed orange juice, carrot-orange-ginger juice, home-brew iced tea. Landon's overnight oats, Ruby's fresh fruit bowl, spinach salad, spanakopita, cheesecake.

## Events
Regular events in the café (e.g. Sundays after church); ribbon cutting with the Apex Chamber and Mayor, March 24, 2026. Contact mustafa@popoverscafe.com to schedule.
